<?php

$points = [[12, -7], [-33, 25], [41, 18], [-8, -44], [27, 39], [-46, -12], [5, 14], [36, -29], [-19, 47], [-2, 3]];
$nearest = [0, 0, PHP_INT_MAX];
$farthest = [0, 0, -1];
for ($i = 0; $i < count($points) - 1; $i++) {
    for ($j = $i + 1; $j < count($points); $j++) {
        $dx = $points[$i][0] - $points[$j][0];
        $dy = $points[$i][1] - $points[$j][1];
        $squared = $dx * $dx + $dy * $dy;
        if ($squared < $nearest[2]) {
            $nearest = [$i, $j, $squared];
        }
        if ($squared > $farthest[2]) {
            $farthest = [$i, $j, $squared];
        }
    }
}
foreach (['closest' => $nearest, 'farthest' => $farthest] as $label => [$i, $j, $squared]) {
    printf("%s: P%d P%d %.4F\n", $label, $i, $j, sqrt($squared));
}
